articles.title: Polanski vows to stay as Green leader as he faces criticism after by-election defeat
articles.summary: Jewish Greens' leader has said Polanski should resign in the wake of a Zionism row and by-election defeat.

articles.title: Trump Media advisor Katie Zacharia offered White House press secretary role
articles.summary: The White House has tapped Katie Zacharia to be its next press secretary, a White House official confirmed to CNBC.

articles.title: THORChain exec accuses Tether of temporarily freezing USDT vaults
articles.summary: Chad Barraford, technical co-founder of the network, said that the funds were frozen and then unfrozen without explanation.

articles.title: Strong earthquakes shake Panama, buildings damaged
articles.summary: Panama's president has declared a "major disaster" after a series of tremors damaged buildings, briefly suspended flights and triggered a tsunami alert in Central and South America.

articles.title: Batteries are now cheaper than natural gas turbines used at many data centers
articles.summary: Batteries are now cheaper than natural gas turbines as the data center boom pushes prices up.
